title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67 - I. Allegro con brio
performer: Fulda Symphonic Orchestra, Simon Schindler, conductor (Orangerie Fulda, 2002)
format: Ogg Vorbis, 44.1 kHz, stereo, about 160 kbps
license: EFF Open Audio License 1.0 (attribution and share-alike, like CC-BY-SA); the composition is public domain. Original source: http://www-plan.cs.colorado.edu/henkel/fso/index-en.html
notes: Complete first movement, including the exposition repeat.

excerpt.notes: Recapitulation and coda, uncut: it fades in over the end of the recapitulation's opening fermata (the hammered lead-in made an abrupt start), keeps the oboe cadenza and ends on the real ending. The exposition and the coda are in different keys, so no clean join between them exists.
excerpt.command: uv run --project tools/analysis ps-analysis crop songs/beethoven-fifth/source.ogg --start 260.45 --end 435.5 --fade-in-ms 1500 --out public/audio/beethoven-fifth.flac
